import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = "items"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(sa.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(255), nullable=False, unique=True)
    active: Mapped[bool | None] = mapped_column(sa.Boolean, nullable=True, unique=False)

import os
import unittest

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from items.api import create_router
from items.models import Base
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


class CrudTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        url = os.environ["TEST_DATABASE_URL"]
        self.engine = create_engine(url)
        Base.metadata.create_all(self.engine)

        def get_session():
            with Session(self.engine) as db:
                yield db

        app = FastAPI()
        app.include_router(create_router(get_session))
        self.client = TestClient(app)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.drop_all(self.engine)
        self.engine.dispose()

    def test_crud(self) -> None:
        payload = {
            "title": "sample",
            "active": True,
        }
        created = self.client.post("/items", json=payload)
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201, created.text)
        item_id = created.json()["id"]
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/items" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.client.get("/items").json()), 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.patch("/items" + f"/{item_id}", json={}).status_code, 200
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete("/items" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/items" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 404)
